title: MAGPIE-Net: Predicting short-duration heavy-rainfall events in station neighborhoods from multitemporal FY-4A AGRI observations
abstract: arXiv:2608.17753v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Short-duration heavy-rainfall warning determines whether 1 h rainfall will exceed a threshold within a target-station neighborhood over the next few hours. Multitemporal infrared and water-vapor observations from the Fengyun-4A Advanced Geostationary Radiation Imager (FY-4A AGRI) capture cloud-top cooling, moisture evolution, and cloud expansion before substantial surface rainfall develops. However, most deep-learning nowcasting methods convert these signals into local warnings by post-processing gridded precipitation predictions, preventing station-neighborhood event targets from directly supervising the satellite-to-station learning pathway. translated_title: MAGPIE-Net：基于多时相FY-4A AGRI观测预测站点邻域短时强降雨事件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17753v1 公告类型：新  摘要：短时强降雨预警用于判断未来几小时内目标站点邻域内1小时降雨量是否超过阈值。风云四号A星先进静止轨道辐射成像仪（FY-4A AGRI）的多时相红外和水汽观测能够捕获地面显著降雨发展前的云顶冷却、水汽演变和云系扩展过程。然而，大多数深度学习临近预报方法通过后处理网格化降水预测来将这些信号转化为局部预警，导致站点邻域事件目标无法直接监督卫星到站点的学习路径。我们提出了MAGPIE-Net，该方法在对流初始化特征、多尺度编码和辅助网格化降水诊断相结合的通路中嵌入了一种地理自适应、可微分的网格到站点映射。因此，站点邻域事件损失能够约束卫星表示的学习过程。
tldr: 本文提出MAGPIE-Net，通过可微分的网格到站点映射，使站点邻域事件损失直接监督卫星观测到站点预警的学习过程，从而提升短时强降雨预测准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MAGPIE-Net, which uses a differentiable grid-to-station mapping to directly supervise the satellite-to-station learning pathway with station-neighborhood event losses, improving short-duration heavy-rainfall prediction accuracy.
